question: Which of the following is the second nearest star to Earth?
options:
Proxima Centauri

Polaris

Sirius

Delta Velorum
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Proxima Centauri

Proxima Centauri is the second nearest star to Earth after the Sun, located approximately 4.24 light-years away. It is part of the Alpha Centauri star system and is a red dwarf star. Although it is not visible to the naked eye, it is a significant subject of astronomical studies. It was discovered in 1915 by Robert Innes.

Extra Facts:
☛ The Sun is the closest star to Earth, located about 8 light-minutes away.
☛ Alpha Centauri A and B are also nearby stars, forming a binary star system.
☛ Proxima Centauri has only about 12% of the Sun's mass and is a very low-luminosity star.

question:
In 1905, who concluded with Thomas Chamberlain that the planets of the Solar System originated from an encounter between the Sun and another star ?

[SSC CPO 2024]
options:
James Hutton

Inge Lehmann

Charles Lyell

Forest Moulton
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Forest Moulton

Explanation:
In 1905, Forest Moulton and Thomas Chamberlain jointly proposed the 'Planetesimal Hypothesis', suggesting that the planets of the Solar System originated from a collision between the Sun and another star. According to this theory, the debris from this encounter condensed to form planets. This hypothesis was one of the leading theories about planetary formation in the early 20th century.

Extra Facts:
• The Planetesimal Hypothesis challenged the earlier 'Nebular Hypothesis' proposed by Immanuel Kant and Pierre-Simon Laplace.
• The modern 'Solar Nebula Theory' is now the most widely accepted explanation for planetary formation.
• Forest Moulton was a renowned astronomer who contributed significantly to the study of planetary motion and origins.

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है फॉरेस्ट मौलटन

Explanation:
1905 में, फॉरेस्ट मौलटन और थॉमस चेम्बरलेन ने संयुक्त रूप से 'ग्रहाणु परिकल्पना' (Planetesimal Hypothesis) प्रस्तुत की। इसके अनुसार, सौर मंडल के ग्रहों की उत्पत्ति सूर्य और एक अन्य तारे के बीच हुए टकराव के परिणामस्वरूप हुई। इस टकराव से निकले पदार्थों के संघनन से ग्रहों का निर्माण हुआ। यह परिकल्पना 20वीं सदी के प्रारंभिक वर्षों में ग्रहों की उत्पत्ति के संबंध में प्रमुख सिद्धांतों में से एक थी।

Extra Facts:
• ग्रहाणु परिकल्पना ने बाद में 'नेबुलर परिकल्पना' (Nebular Hypothesis) को चुनौती दी, जिसे इमैनुएल कांट और पियरे-साइमन लाप्लास ने प्रस्तावित किया था।
• आधुनिक समय में, 'सौर निहारिका सिद्धांत' (Solar Nebula Theory) को ग्रहों की उत्पत्ति का सबसे स्वीकृत सिद्धांत माना जाता है।
• फॉरेस्ट मौलटन एक प्रसिद्ध खगोलशास्त्री थे, जिन्होंने ग्रहों की गति और उनकी उत्पत्ति पर महत्वपूर्ण शोध किया।

question:
Which of the following statements most accurately describes the planet Saturn?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options:
It is a gas giant made up mostly of hydrogen and helium and the density is less than that of water

Its surface is reddish in colour.

It was the seventh planet discovered in the Solar System.

Its cloud-like outer regions consist of methane in the gaseous form and ammonia in crystalline form.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It is a gas giant made up mostly of hydrogen and helium and the density is less than that of water.

Explanation:

The statement that most accurately describes the planet Saturn is: It is a gas giant made up mostly of hydrogen and helium and the density is less than that of water.

This is a defining characteristic of Saturn, which is the least dense planet in our solar system. Its density is lower than that of water, meaning it would float.

Other Options

  • Its surface is reddish in colour: This is incorrect. The planet Mars is known for its reddish hue due to iron oxide. Saturn's atmosphere has bands of a pale yellow-brown or golden color.
  • It was the seventh planet discovered in the Solar System: This is also incorrect. Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and has been known since antiquity. The seventh planet, Uranus, was the first to be discovered using a telescope.

  • Its cloud-like outer regions consist of methane in the gaseous form and ammonia in crystalline form: This description is more accurate for the 'ice giants,' Uranus and Neptune. While Saturn has trace amounts of methane and ammonia, its primary atmospheric components are hydrogen and helium.
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन शनि ग्रह का सबसे सटीक वर्णन करता है?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options_hi:
यह एक गैसीय दानव है जो मुख्यतः हाइड्रोजन और हीलियम से बना है और इसका घनत्व पानी से भी कम है।

इसकी सतह का रंग लाल होता है।

यह सौरमंडल में खोजा गया सातवाँ ग्रह था

इसके बादल जैसे बाहरी क्षेत्रों में गैसीय रूप में मीथेन और क्रिस्टलीय रूप में अमोनिया पाई जाती है।
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है यह एक गैस का बना विशाल पिंड है, जो मुख्य रूप से हाइड्रोजन और हीलियम से बना है और जिसका घनत्व पानी की तुलना में कम है।

Explanation:

शनि ग्रह का सबसे सटीक वर्णन करने वाला कथन यह है: यह एक गैसीय दानव है जो मुख्यतः हाइड्रोजन और हीलियम से बना है और इसका घनत्व पानी से भी कम है।

यह शनि की एक विशिष्ट विशेषता है, जो हमारे सौरमंडल का सबसे कम घनत्व वाला ग्रह है। इसका घनत्व पानी से भी कम है, जिसका अर्थ है कि यह तैर सकता है।

अन्य विकल्प

  • इसकी सतह का रंग लाल है: यह गलत है। मंगल ग्रह आयरन ऑक्साइड के कारण अपने लाल रंग के लिए जाना जाता है। शनि के वायुमंडल में हल्के पीले-भूरे या सुनहरे रंग की धारियाँ हैं।
  • यह सौरमंडल में खोजा गया सातवाँ ग्रह था: यह भी गलत है। शनि सूर्य से छठा ग्रह है और प्राचीन काल से ही ज्ञात है। सातवाँ ग्रह, यूरेनस, दूरबीन से खोजा जाने वाला पहला ग्रह था।
  • इसके बादल जैसे बाहरी क्षेत्रों में गैसीय रूप में मीथेन और क्रिस्टलीय रूप में अमोनिया होता है: यह विवरण 'बर्फ के दानवों' यूरेनस और नेपच्यून के लिए अधिक सटीक है। यद्यपि शनि ग्रह पर मीथेन और अमोनिया की मात्रा नगण्य है, परन्तु इसके प्राथमिक वायुमंडलीय घटक हाइड्रोजन और हीलियम हैं।

question:
_________ is the closest star to the Earth.

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options:
Altair

Sun

Moon

Vega
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Sun

Explanation:
The Sun is the closest star to the Earth, located at an average distance of 149.6 million kilometers. It is the center of our solar system and provides essential light and heat, making life on Earth possible. The Sun is classified as a G-type main-sequence star (Yellow Dwarf) and its gravitational force holds all planets, moons, and other celestial bodies in orbit. Without the Sun, Earth would be a frozen, lifeless planet.

Extra Facts:
☛ The Sun's diameter is approximately 1.39 million kilometers, about 109 times larger than Earth.
☛ The Sun's mass is roughly 330,000 times that of Earth.
☛ The surface temperature of the Sun is around 5,500°C, while its core reaches up to 15 million°C.
☛ The Sun generates energy through nuclear fusion, converting hydrogen into helium.

question:
In early 1610, who discovered with his newly invented telescope that Jupiter has four moons?

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: Simon Marius
Tycho Brahe
Galileo Galilei
Johannes Kepler
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Galileo Galilei

Explanation:
In early 1610, Galileo Galilei used his newly invented telescope to discover Jupiter's four largest moons (Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto). This discovery was pivotal in the astronomical revolution, challenging the geocentric model of the universe and supporting Copernicus' heliocentric theory. Galileo's observations laid the foundation for modern astronomy and emphasized the importance of empirical evidence in science.

Extra Facts:
Galileo also observed lunar craters, the phases of Venus, and Saturn's rings (though he did not identify them correctly). His work promoted the scientific method but led to conflict with the Church, resulting in his house arrest in 1633. His discoveries revolutionized humanity's understanding of the cosmos and paved the way for future astronomers like Kepler and Newton.

question:
A _____ is a cloud of dust and gas inside a galaxy.

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: black hole
photosphere
nebula
chromosphere
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is nebula

Explanation:
A nebula is a massive cloud of dust and gas found inside a galaxy. It is known as the birthplace of stars, as gravitational forces cause it to collapse and form new stars. Nebulae are primarily composed of hydrogen, helium, and other ionized gases. They can appear bright or dark, depending on whether they emit light or not. For example, the Orion Nebula is a famous emission nebula visible to the naked eye from Earth.

Extra Facts:
Nebulae are broadly classified into four types: emission nebulae (which produce their own light), reflection nebulae (which reflect light from nearby stars), absorption nebulae (which absorb light and appear dark), and planetary nebulae (formed by dying stars). These play a crucial role in the formation of stars and planets in the universe.

question:
Which scientist revised the nebular hypothesis in 1796?

[SSC CGL 2023]
options:
Neville Chamberlain

Edwin Hubble

Pierre Laplace

Harold Jeffrey
solution:
Correct Answer is Option 3, i.e., Pierre Laplace

 In 1796, Pierre Laplace revised and popularised the nebular hypothesis, which explains the formation of the solar system. He expanded Immanuel Kant’s earlier idea, proposing that the Sun and planets originated from a rotating cloud of gas and dust (nebula). As this nebula cooled and contracted, rings of material condensed to form planets. This theory laid the foundation for the modern Solar Nebula Model, which is still widely accepted for explaining planetary system formation.

solution:

Explanation:
Before the discovery of Neptune, astronomers observed irregularities in the orbit of Uranus that could not be explained by known gravitational forces. Urbain-Jean-Joseph Le Verrier, a French mathematician and astronomer, studied these gravity-induced disturbances and mathematically predicted the approximate location of Neptune. Based on his calculations, Johann Gottfried Galle observed Neptune in 1846, confirming its existence. This event marked a milestone in astronomy, demonstrating the power of celestial mechanics and mathematical predictions in planetary discovery.

Extra Facts:
Neptune is the eighth planet from the Sun and is classified as an 'Ice Giant' due to its composition of ice and gases. Its discovery validated Newton's Law of Gravitation and highlighted the role of mathematics in astronomy. Neptune's atmosphere consists mainly of hydrogen, helium, and methane, giving it a distinct blue color. It has 14 known moons, with Triton being the largest. Neptune also has a faint ring system and exhibits the strongest winds in the solar system.

solution:

Explanation:
Halley's Comet is a famous periodic comet that passes near Earth approximately every 75-76 years. It is named after the astronomer Edmond Halley, who calculated its orbit. The last appearance of Halley's Comet was in 1986, so its next appearance will be in 1986 + 76 = 2061. This comet originates from the outer regions of the solar system and becomes visible when it approaches the Sun. Its study is crucial for astronomers as it provides insights into the formation and evolution of the solar system.

Extra Facts:
Comets are composed of ice, dust, and rocky material, often referred to as 'dirty snowballs'. Halley's Comet has been recorded since 240 BCE in historical documents. It was also visible during the Battle of Hastings in 1066, as depicted in the Bayeux Tapestry. A comet's tail always points away from the Sun due to solar wind pushing material off its surface.

Which of the following is an outer planet of the solar system?

Saturn

Explanation:
The planets of the solar system are divided into two categories - Inner Planets and Outer Planets. The inner planets (Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars) are located closer to the Sun and are small, rocky, and dense. On the other hand, the outer planets (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune) are located farther from the Sun and are large, gaseous, and have low density. Saturn is a gas giant and the second-largest planet in the solar system, making it an outer planet.

Extra Facts:
The outer planets are also called 'Jovian Planets' because they share characteristics similar to Jupiter. These planets have ring systems, with Saturn's rings being the most prominent. They are primarily composed of hydrogen and helium and have numerous moons. Due to their distance from the Sun, outer planets have extremely low temperatures.

question:

Asteroid Belt
Kuiper Belt
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kuiper Belt

Explanation:
The Kuiper Belt is a flat, ring-like structure composed of small, icy bodies that orbit the Sun beyond Neptune's orbit. It includes dwarf planets like Pluto and is considered a source of short-period comets. Unlike the Oort Cloud, which is spherical and much farther away, the Kuiper Belt is closer and disk-shaped. The Asteroid Belt, located between Mars and Jupiter, consists mainly of rocky bodies, not icy ones.

Extra Facts:
Discovered in 1992, the Kuiper Belt represents remnants of the solar system's formation. Objects here are called Kuiper Belt Objects (KBOs). Pluto, once considered the ninth planet, is now the largest known KBO. NASA's New Horizons mission explored Pluto in 2015, providing valuable data about this distant region.

क्विपर पट्टी एक चपटी वलयाकार संरचना है जो वरुण (नेपच्यून) ग्रह की कक्षा के बाहर सूर्य की परिक्रमा करती है। यह छोटे, बर्फीले पिंडों से बनी है, जिनमें प्लूटो जैसे बौने ग्रह भी शामिल हैं। यह सौर मंडल का एक महत्वपूर्ण भाग है और धूमकेतुओं का स्रोत माना जाता है। ऊर्ट बादल, जो कि एक गोलाकार बादल है, क्विपर पट्टी से अधिक दूर स्थित है और दीर्घकालिक धूमकेतुओं का स्रोत माना जाता है। क्षुद्रग्रह पट्टी मंगल और बृहस्पति के बीच स्थित है और मुख्यतः चट्टानी पिंडों से बनी है।

Extra Facts:
क्विपर पट्टी की खोज 1992 में हुई थी और यह सौर मंडल के निर्माण के बचे हुए अवशेषों का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है। यहाँ पाए जाने वाले पिंडों को क्विपर बेल्ट ऑब्जेक्ट्स (KBOs) कहा जाता है। प्लूटो, जिसे पहले ग्रह माना जाता था, अब क्विपर पट्टी का सबसे बड़ा ज्ञात सदस्य है। यह क्षेत्र न्यू होराइजन्स मिशन का प्रमुख लक्ष्य था, जिसने 2015 में प्लूटो का अध्ययन किया था।

question:
Which dwarf planet orbits the sun in 310 years at a distance between 38.5 to 53 AU?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: Eris
Ceres
Makemake
Pluto
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Makemake

Explanation:
Makemake is a dwarf planet located in the Kuiper Belt. It orbits the Sun at an average distance of 38.5 to 53 AU (Astronomical Units) and completes one revolution in approximately 310 years. Discovered in 2005, it was classified as a dwarf planet in 2008. Like Pluto, Makemake is a Trans-Neptunian Object (TNO), but its orbit is more elongated. With a diameter of about 1,430 km, it is the third-largest dwarf planet after Pluto and Eris.

Extra Facts:
• The Kuiper Belt is a vast region of icy bodies beyond Neptune's orbit, hosting several dwarf planets.
• Makemake is named after the creation deity of the Rapa Nui civilization.
• Its surface is covered with methane, ethane, and nitrogen ice, making it highly reflective.
• Unlike Pluto and Eris, Makemake has no known moons.

Explanation:
मेकमेक (Makemake) एक बौना ग्रह (dwarf planet) है जो कुइपर बेल्ट (Kuiper Belt) में स्थित है। यह सूर्य से औसतन 38.5 से 53 AU (खगोलीय इकाई) की दूरी पर स्थित है और सूर्य की एक परिक्रमा लगभग 310 वर्षों में पूरी करता है। इसे 2005 में खोजा गया था और 2008 में इसे बौना ग्रह का दर्जा दिया गया। यह प्लूटो (Pluto) के समान ही एक ट्रांस-नेप्च्यूनियन ऑब्जेक्ट (Trans-Neptunian Object) है, लेकिन प्लूटो की तुलना में इसकी कक्षा अधिक दूर तक फैली हुई है। मेकमेक का व्यास लगभग 1,430 किमी है, जो इसे प्लूटो और इरिस (Eris) के बाद तीसरा सबसे बड़ा बौना ग्रह बनाता है।

Extra Facts:

• मेकमेक का नाम रापा नुई (Rapa Nui) सभ्यता के सृजन देवता के नाम पर रखा गया है।
• इसकी सतह मीथेन, इथेन और नाइट्रोजन से बर्फ से ढकी हुई है, जिसके कारण यह अत्यधिक परावर्तक (reflective) है।
• अभी तक मेकमेक का कोई ज्ञात चंद्रमा नहीं है, जबकि प्लूटो और इरिस के चंद्रमा हैं।

question: With reference to space science, which of the following planets do NOT have even one moon?
options:
Venus and Mercury

Jupiter and Saturn

Neptune and Mars

Uranus and Neptune
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. Venus and Mercury.

Among the eight planets, only Venus and Mercury do not have any natural satellites. Their proximity to the Sun and relatively weak gravitational fields prevent them from capturing or retaining moons. In contrast, outer planets like Jupiter and Saturn have multiple moons due to their strong gravity.

question:
Which of the following planets does NOT have rings?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options:
Uranus

Saturn

Venus

Jupiter
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. Venus.

Venus does not have rings. While all four gas giants—Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune—are known to have ring systems, the terrestrial planets (Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars) do not. Saturn's rings are the most prominent and well-known, composed mainly of ice particles. Jupiter, Uranus, and Neptune have much fainter ring systems, often made of dust and darker material. Venus, which is similar in size and mass to Earth, has no rings or moons.

question:
A distinctive cross-shaped constellation best seen in the northern hemisphere during the summer and fall months around September is:

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: Cygnus
Ursa Major
Pegasus
Cassiopeia
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cygnus

Explanation:
The Cygnus constellation, also known as the 'Northern Cross', is a distinctive cross-shaped constellation best visible in the northern hemisphere during summer and autumn months (especially around September). It lies along the plane of the Milky Way and includes the bright star Deneb, which is part of the Summer Triangle. Due to its swan-like shape, it is also called the 'Swan Constellation'. Its prominent cross pattern makes it easily identifiable in the night sky.

Extra Facts:
The Cygnus constellation is significant in astronomy as it contains several deep-sky objects (e.g., nebulae and star clusters). It is part of the Summer Triangle, which includes stars like Vega (Lyra) and Altair (Aquila). Located approximately 1,500 light-years away, its brightest star, Deneb, is a supergiant. Cygnus is also home to the Cygnus X-1, a famous black hole system.

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है सिग्नस (Cygnus)

Explanation:
सिग्नस (Cygnus) तारामंडल को 'उत्तरी क्रॉस' (Northern Cross) के नाम से भी जाना जाता है। यह एक विशिष्ट क्रॉस-आकार का तारामंडल है जो उत्तरी गोलार्ध में गर्मियों और पतझड़ के महीनों (विशेषकर सितंबर) में स्पष्ट रूप से दिखाई देता है। यह मिल्की वे (आकाशगंगा) के समतल में स्थित है और इसमें चमकीले तारे डेनेब (Deneb) शामिल हैं, जो 'समर ट्राएंगल' (Summer Triangle) का एक हिस्सा है। इसकी आकृति एक हंस (Swan) जैसी भी दिखती है, इसलिए इसे 'हंस तारामंडल' भी कहते हैं।

सिग्नस तारामंडल खगोलीय अध्ययन में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि इसमें कई डीप-स्काई ऑब्जेक्ट्स (जैसे नेबुला और स्टार क्लस्टर) शामिल हैं। यह ग्रीष्मकालीन त्रिकोण (Summer Triangle) का हिस्सा है, जिसमें वेगा (Lyra) और अल्टेयर (Aquila) तारे भी शामिल हैं। यह तारामंडल पृथ्वी से लगभग 1,500 प्रकाश-वर्ष दूर स्थित है और इसका सबसे चमकीला तारा डेनेब, एक सुपरजाइंट स्टार है।

question:
Which of the following statements about planet Saturn is true?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: Saturn is the fourth planet from the Sun and the largest planet in our solar system.
Satellites like Enceladus and Titan of Saturn are home to internal oceans, could possibly support life.
Saturn's environment is conducive to life.
Saturn is a massive ball made up mostly of nitrogen.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Satellites like Enceladus and Titan of Saturn are home to internal oceans, could possibly support life.

Explanation:
Saturn's moons Enceladus and Titan have been discovered to harbor internal oceans. Enceladus shows geysers erupting water vapor and organic compounds from its south pole, indicating potential ingredients for life. Titan possesses lakes of methane and ethane, suggesting a complex organic chemistry system. Though these moons are not in the 'habitable zone', their internal heat and chemical composition make them candidates for extraterrestrial life. Saturn itself is a gas giant with an atmosphere inhospitable to life, composed mainly of hydrogen and helium.

Extra Facts:
Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and the second-largest planet after Jupiter. Its iconic ring system consists of ice, dust, and rocky debris. Saturn's atmosphere is 96% hydrogen and 3% helium, not nitrogen. Its moon Titan is larger than Mercury and has a dense atmosphere, unique among moons. The Cassini-Huygens mission provided groundbreaking data about Saturn and its moons.

Explanation:
शनि ग्रह के उपग्रह एन्सेलेडस और टाइटन पर वैज्ञानिकों ने आंतरिक महासागरों की खोज की है। एन्सेलेडस के दक्षिणी ध्रुव से जलवाष्प और कार्बनिक यौगिकों का विस्फोट देखा गया है, जो जीवन के लिए आवश्यक तत्व हो सकते हैं। टाइटन पर मीथेन और इथेन की झीलें पाई गई हैं, जो एक जटिल कार्बनिक रसायन प्रणाली को दर्शाती हैं। ये उपग्रह 'हैबिटेबल ज़ोन' में नहीं हैं, लेकिन उनके आंतरिक गर्मी और रासायनिक संरचना के कारण जीवन की संभावना बनी हुई है। शनि स्वयं एक गैस दानव है और इसका वातावरण जीवन के लिए अनुकूल नहीं है।

question:
____ oblong orbit overlaps the orbit of Neptune.

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: Jupiter’s
Pluto’s
Venus’
Mars’
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pluto’s

Explanation:
Pluto’s oblong (highly elliptical) orbit overlaps Neptune’s orbit. Pluto is a dwarf planet whose orbit is so elongated that a part of it lies inside Neptune’s orbit, making it occasionally closer to the Sun than Neptune. This unique orbital behavior is rare in the solar system, as most planets have nearly circular orbits that do not intersect. Pluto’s reclassification as a dwarf planet in 2006 by the IAU was partly due to its irregular orbit and inability to clear its orbital neighborhood.

Extra Facts:
☛ Pluto has five known moons, with Charon being the largest (half Pluto’s size), forming a binary system.
☛ It takes Pluto 248 Earth years to complete one orbit around the Sun, with an average distance of 5.9 billion km.
☛ Pluto’s surface is covered with nitrogen and methane ice, giving it a reddish-brown appearance.

question:
The different patterns formed by different group of stars are called :

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: planets
constellations
celestial bodies
stars
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is constellations

Explanation:
Constellations are the different patterns formed by groups of stars in the night sky. These patterns have been recognized since ancient times and are used for navigation, calendar-making, and astronomical studies. For example, the 'Great Bear' (Saptarishi) and 'Orion' are well-known constellations. Though these stars appear close together from Earth, they may actually be far apart in space. Constellations help astronomers map the sky and identify celestial objects.

Extra Facts:
The International Astronomical Union (IAU) officially recognizes 88 constellations, out of which 12 belong to the Zodiac, significant in astrology. Constellations have deep cultural and mythological associations across civilizations. The study of constellations is one of the oldest branches of astronomy and has been crucial in understanding the universe's structure. Modern astronomy still uses constellations as reference points for locating stars, galaxies, and other cosmic phenomena.

[RRB NTPC CBT]

सितारे
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है तारामंडल

Explanation:
तारामंडल (Constellations) तारों के समूह द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रतिरूपों को कहा जाता है। ये प्रतिरूप आकाश में एक विशिष्ट आकृति बनाते हैं जिन्हें प्राचीन काल से ही पहचाना जाता रहा है। तारामंडलों का उपयोग नेविगेशन, कैलेंडर बनाने और खगोलीय अध्ययन में किया जाता है। उदाहरण के लिए, 'सप्तऋषि' (Great Bear) और 'ओरायन' (Orion) प्रसिद्ध तारामंडल हैं। ये तारामंडल पृथ्वी से देखने पर एक विशेष आकार प्रदर्शित करते हैं, हालांकि वास्तव में इनके तारे एक-दूसरे से बहुत दूर हो सकते हैं।

Extra Facts:
तारामंडलों को अंतर्राष्ट्रीय खगोलीय संघ (IAU) द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त 88 आधिकारिक तारामंडलों में विभाजित किया गया है। इनमें से 12 राशि चक्र (Zodiac) के तारामंडल हैं, जो ज्योतिष में महत्वपूर्ण माने जाते हैं। तारामंडलों का अध्ययन खगोल विज्ञान की प्राचीनतम शाखाओं में से एक है और यह विभिन्न संस्कृतियों में पौराणिक कथाओं से जुड़ा हुआ है।
